LanguageData.EPK.FloatMenu.KissTooltip: Walk over, face {TARGET}, share a kiss, then both return to where they stood.
LanguageData.EPK.Fail.Disabled: kissing is disabled in mod settings
LanguageData.EPK.Fail.NonHumanlike: non-humanlike targets are disabled in mod settings
LanguageData.EPK.Fail.Busy: already in the middle of a kiss
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.TimingHint: Every duration is stored in ticks and shown as ticks / real seconds / game hours. Reference: 60 t = 1 real second at 1x speed, 2500 t = 1 game hour, 60000 t = 1 game day.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.EnabledDesc: Master switch. Off removes the right-click option; ongoing kisses finish normally.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.DurationDesc: How long the two stand there kissing. Hearts spawn repeatedly inside this window.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.FleckIntervalDesc: Gap between heart bursts. Vanilla lovemakin' uses 100 t.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.PawnCooldownDesc: How long a pawn must wait before kissing anyone again. Vanilla social interactions only cool down for 120 t.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.PairCooldownDesc: How long the same two pawns must wait before kissing each other again. Set to 0 for free-for-all.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.ThoughtDurationDesc: How long the mood bonus lingers after a kiss.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.MoodMultiplierDesc: Scales the final mood bonus. Actual bonus = thought base x this x the pawn's own social impact, so a smooth talker gets more out of a kiss than a mute grump.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.AllowHostileDesc: Let you order a kiss at pawns that are currently hostile. They may react... physically.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.AllowNonHumanlikeDesc: Let any pawn be involved, including animals, mechanoids, drones and entities. They have no mood, so they gain nothing but the gesture.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.ChangeOpinionDesc: Also shift how the two pawns feel about each other. This feeds the vanilla romance chain - keep it off if you just want silly kissing.
LanguageData.EPK.Settings.ReturnHomeDesc: Afterwards both pawn go back to where the kiss was ordered. A polite request - urgent needs and work still win.
